$comment: Thin Open VSX listings for HoverDeck, one per agent. Each is a manifest with no code: it depends on DenysDavydov.hoverdeck and sets hoverdeck.chat.defaultAgent. Built by scripts/package-listings.mjs; see CLAUDE.md, 'Per-agent listings on Open VSX'.

listings.name: hoverdeck-for-gemini
listings.description: Gemini CLI in a VS Code chat with a built-in browser, Git and terminals — drive pages, review diffs and approve every tool call. Installs HoverDeck with Gemini as the default agent.
listings.install: Install Gemini CLI (`npm install -g @google/gemini-cli`) and sign in once by running `gemini` in a terminal.
notes: The chat's Gemini gets HoverDeck's browser tools automatically. A `gemini` you start in a HoverDeck terminal tab does not: Gemini CLI reads MCP servers only from its settings files, and HoverDeck writes nothing into your repository.

listings.name: hoverdeck-for-opencode
listings.description: OpenCode in a VS Code chat with a built-in browser, Git and terminals — any model OpenCode supports, with approvals for every command and edit. Installs HoverDeck with OpenCode as the default agent.
listings.install: Install OpenCode (`curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash`) and sign in with `opencode auth login`.

listings.name: hoverdeck-for-pi
listings.description: The Pi coding agent in a VS Code chat with a built-in browser, Git and terminals — with an approval for every tool call Pi makes. Installs HoverDeck with Pi as the default agent.
listings.install: Install Pi (`npm install -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`, Node.js 20 or later) and sign in by running `pi` and typing `/login`.
notes: Pi has no approval system of its own; HoverDeck adds one, so every tool call Pi makes is asked about in the chat unless you set its category to Auto.

listings.name: hoverdeck-for-openrouter
listings.displayName: HoverDeck for OpenRouter, Ollama & LM Studio
listings.description: Chat with any OpenRouter model, or a local one from Ollama or LM Studio, in VS Code — with a built-in browser the model can drive. Installs HoverDeck with OpenRouter as the default agent.
listings.install: Open **Chat Settings → OpenRouter** in the HoverDeck chat. For OpenRouter, store your API key and add models from the catalogue. For a local model, pick **Ollama** (`http://localhost:11434/v1`) or **LM Studio** (`http://localhost:1234/v1`) as the catalogue's source and add a model — no key is needed and nothing leaves your computer.
notes: This agent's tools are HoverDeck's browser, editor and chat tools. It has no shell and does not edit files: for that, use Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode or Pi in the same chat.
Small local models often call tools badly; switch **Supports tools** off for such a model in its settings.
